task: Extend the personal spending panel (/v1/analytics/budget_usage and SpendingCard) with Default-project badges and ordering, enforcement-off and override project rows, and a live user-scoped, per-project-locked refresh of project_budget spend rows with touch-unchanged semantics, keeping admin spending endpoints unchanged.

key_reasoning.reason: Six components across two repos: spending router, BudgetUsageService (row assembly, ordering, percent), MemberSpendService.get_user_project_rows (enforcement filter, limit via member_effective_max_budget, refresh), ProjectSpendTrackingRepository (new project_budget touch + project advisory lock), provider protocol + no-op + LiteLLM adapter (new project-scoped spend method), and codemie-ui SpendingCard. Base XL; bumped because get_user_project_rows and project_budget rows are shared foundations read by admin endpoints, reset cutoffs, project list/detail spending and the nightly collector.

Closest pattern is the merged _refresh_user_member_spend / collect_member_budget_spend_for_allocations / try_lock_member_refresh / touch_member_spend_dates path, which covers most mechanics, but it targets member_budget rows. Applying it to project_budget rows has no exact precedent: live writes and touched spend_dates shift get_project_reset_cutoffs_for_projects, the nightly collector baseline and lifetime spend, while admin endpoints must stay byte-identical and a prior attempt (EPMCDME-12991) was reverted for row growth. The AC edge cases (reset transition, InvalidSpendSnapshotError per project, touch-unchanged) are covered by the existing _patched / TestUserScopedRefresh harness, so no test-template bump. Project LiteLLM creds handling reuses the existing SettingsService path, so no security-gap bump.

About 7-8 backend source files (spending router, budget_usage_service, member_spend_service, project_spend_tracking_repository, provider protocol, provider_registry, budget_provider_adapter, possibly project_budget_repository), 4-5 backend test files, SpendingCard.tsx plus a new SpendingCard test in codemie-ui. 11-15 modified across multiple subsystems in two repos.

UI, API, Service, DB-Persistence (new project_budget write/touch and locking, no schema change) and the External LiteLLM /key/info integration, with cross-cutting freshness/consistency concerns across several layers.

Requirements are detailed with a worked example, but design choices remain open: how the per-row default flag reaches the UI without breaking the '<email> (cli)' label, matching member rows (project_budget_id) to project totals (project_name, category), and how touched rows interact with reset cutoffs.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from XL to XXL: touches core shared utilities (get_user_project_rows and project_budget spend rows shared with admin endpoints, reset cutoffs, project spending pages and the nightly collector)
